claims.claim_text: The private identifier printed for Frank G. Burns resolves to an official Army record for a different person, so the indexed identity remains conflicting.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Exact identifier comparison produced a different name in the official Army file; the unrelated name and identifier are withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The identifier disagreement is direct official conflict evidence. No Army identity, rank, occupation, or employer is assigned to Frank G. Burns.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflicting Army record cannot establish Frank G. Burns's chronology, occupation, or employment.
claims.match_notes: The unrelated Army subject is intentionally omitted from the public claim and exports. Same-name military, directory, obituary, and institutional candidates also lacked Box 95 linkage.
